name: Jehu
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The Lord sent Elijah back to the wilderness of Damascus to anoint Hazael to be king over Syria, Jehu the son of Nimshi to be king over Israel, and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah to be prophet in his room. Him that escaped the sword of Hazael would Jehu slay, and him that escaped Jehu would Elisha slay.

note.label: 1 Kings 19: A Still Small Voice

points: The Most High was telling Elijah not to worry, for he had things set up: Syria would come against the northern kingdom, Jehu would rise up to slay Ahab and all his house, and Elisha would pick up where Elijah left off when it was his time to come home.

note.label: 1 Kings 19: A Still Small Voice

points: Jehu's men asked, wherefore came this mad fellow to thee? When he told them what happened, they hasted, put their garments under him on the top of the stairs, blew with trumpets, and said, Jehu is king.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehu's fellow captains ask why the mad fellow came, and when he tells them the prophet anointed him king, they hasten to put their garments under him and blow the trumpets, proclaiming Jehu king.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Jehu conspires against Jehoram and charges that none escape the city to carry the news to Jezreel.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: A watchman spies Jehu's company, and two horsemen sent to ask if it is peace are each told to turn behind him and do not return, for the driving is furious like the driving of Jehu.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Joram, the son of Ahab and Jezebel, rode out to meet Jehu and asked, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many? There's no peace as long as you got a wicked woman in power. And that's what America likes to do: set up wicked women and empower women that go against God.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehoram himself goes out and asks if it is peace, and Jehu answers that there can be no peace while the whoredoms and witchcrafts of his mother Jezebel are so many.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Joram turned his hands and fled, saying, There is treachery, O Ahaziah. And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehu draws his bow with full strength and smites Jehoram through the heart, then casts him into the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite according to the word of the Most High.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Ahaziah king of Judah flees but Jehu pursues and has him smitten in his chariot; he flees to Megiddo and dies there.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: When Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it, and she painted her face and tired her head and looked out at a window. Armies coming into the city, and all she's thinking about is putting on makeup. A lot of women lead with how they look, not with God on their mind. She thought she was going to impress him.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehu writes to the rulers of Jezreel who kept Ahab's seventy sons, challenging them to set up a son and fight, but they are exceedingly afraid because two kings could not stand before him.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: The heads are laid in two heaps at the gate, and Jehu slays all that remained of the house of Ahab, his great men, kinsfolk, and priests, until none remained, according to the word spoken by Elijah.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: Jehu meets the brethren of Ahaziah going to salute the king's children and has all forty-two of them slain at the pit of the shearing house, guilty by association with the house of Ahab.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: Jehu gathers all the worshippers of Baal by pretending he will serve Baal much more than Ahab did, doing it in subtilty to destroy them.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: After the sacrifice he sends in the guard to slay them all, breaks down the images and the house of Baal, and makes it a draught house, so Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: Though Jehu destroys Baal out of Israel, he does not depart from the golden calves that Jeroboam set up in Bethel and in Dan; hold Dan in mind for later scriptures.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: The Most High commends Jehu for executing what is right against the house of Ahab and promises his children to the fourth generation shall sit on the throne of Israel.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: Yet Jehu takes no heed to walk in the law of the Most High with all his heart, showing that a man may do great things and still turn away and stay in sin.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: The rest of Jehu's acts are written in the book of the Chronicles of the kings of Israel, and he reigns twenty-eight years in Samaria before Jehoahaz his son reigns in his place.

note.label: 2 Kings 10: Jehu Destroys Baal and Falls Short of the Law

points: Jehoash began to reign in the seventh year of Jehu and reigned forty years in Jerusalem.

note.label: 2 Kings 12: Repairing the House and Dealing Faithfully

points: Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria and did evil, following the sins of Jeroboam.

note.label: 2 Kings 13: The Death of Elisha and the Arrows of Deliverance

points: The end of Zachariah fulfills the word spoken to Jehu, that his sons would sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.

note.label: 2 Kings 15: The Kings of a Divided House

points: He went down to see the wounded Jehoram at Jezreel, and the destruction of Ahaziah was of the Most High, for by going he came into the path of Jehu, whom the Most High had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: That same Jehu who killed the seventy sons of Ahab found the princes of Judah and the sons of Ahaziah's brethren and slew them, then sought and caught Ahaziah, who was hid in Samaria.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: The Lord tells him to call his name Jezreel, for in a little while he will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu and cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.

note.label: Hosea 1: A Wife of Whoredoms and the Sand of the Sea
